newsitem.title: CANADA: Hees, Edper Group to merge.
newsitem.headline: Hees, Edper Group to merge.

text.p: Edper Group Ltd and Hees International Bancorp Inc said on Thursday they plan to merge the two companies, with Edper A and B shareholders getting 0.38 a share and Hees common shareholders receiving one share of the new company's shares for each share now held.
The move continues a process of simplification of the Hees-Edper group's interlocking shareholdings begun several years ago.
The merged entity will be called The Edper Group Ltd.
Each firm's holders of preferred shares and convertible debentures will receive equivalent securities in the new company, they said.
"The conversion rate on the Edper Group 7 percent debentures due 2006 will change from C$5.50 per Edper Group share to $14.47 per share of the amalgamated company," they said.
Investment holding firm Edper already owns a 47 percent common share stake in Hees International, a merchant bank with interests in natural resources and other sectors.

"The amalgamated company will continue to controlled by Partners Ltd which today controls Hees through its control of The Edper Group," it said. And it will pay quarterly dividends totaling C$0.98 per year for each share, equal to the present dividend policy of Hees.
Partners is a private firm owned by Peter Bronfman and 25 business colleagues.
After the merger, "Hees' public shareholders increase their ownership from 52.8 percent of Hees today to 54.2 percent of the amalgamated company," they said.
Edper shareholders will see their dividends increase to C$0.37 a share from C$0.30.
